subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should OpenClaw expose these three indexed transcript writer-lock facts as supported plugin-SDK APIs for bundled and external plugins, or keep this capability internal until a broader SDK contract is approved?
rationale: The patch is additive and documented, but its methods establish a new public persistence contract while the only current adopters are bundled Codex and Copilot extensions; this is a maintainership and API-boundary choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK contract
options.body: Merge or rebase the parent, then accept the three documented methods as stable writer-lock facts and review the combined stack for upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep the facts internal
options.body: Ask for a refactor that leaves the indexed helpers behind an internal bundled-extension seam until a broader external plugin need is established.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK contract
recommendation.body: Merge or rebase the parent, then accept the three documented methods as stable writer-lock facts and review the combined stack for upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the parent foundation and this dependent adopter, so they are the best available routing contact for clarifying the proposed API boundary.
